condition_2_no_new_errors_elsewhere.path_artifact_note: errors identical to a baseline error once every absolute path is erased — the same pre-existing error seen under a different tree name. Reported, never silently dropped.

diff_rejection.note: patterns are matched on ADDED lines only; matching the whole file would reject a task for `any` casts the seed already contained

path_normalisation_note: tsc embeds absolute paths in some messages, and the baseline tree and the arm tree sit at different paths. Without normalising the tree root out, the SAME pre-existing error hashes differently and an untouched file reads as a regression. The frozen acceptance rule is unchanged; an environment difference is removed, not a code difference. This count is reported so the correction can never be silent.
